text:
Get model answers without giving callers the provider key. Ask a question, request a structured decision, embed text, or look up models, prices and the account's credit. Send ask with a prompt, or one of the methods below.
ask <prompt...>: Get a model answer. Send prompt text for a text reply with its tokens and cost, or an OpenAI chat request for the provider response as JSON.
  prompt (json): Prompt text, or an OpenAI chat-completions object in JSON; text returns assistant text, an object returns provider JSON
decide <body...>: Get answers to typed decision questions. Send an OpenRouter Decisions request; the reply is the full provider response as JSON.
  body (string): Raw JSON request, including state, questions and the decision model; sent unchanged
models: List the provider's models; the configured default is marked.
model <id>: See one model's context length, prices and input kinds, per provider endpoint.
  id (string): Model ID, such as openai/gpt-4.1-mini
embed <input...>: Turn text into vectors. Send a text, or a JSON list of texts; the reply is the model and one vector per text.
  input (json): A text, or a JSON list of texts; too many texts for one answer are refused
balance: See the account's remaining credit; role: maintainer
key: See the key's spend limit, remaining credit and rate limit, never the key itself; role: maintainer
